text: Agile methodology is a modern way of managing projects, especially in software development. Instead of planning everything at the start, teams work in short cycles called sprints, usually lasting two to four weeks. Before each sprint, the team chooses tasks from a backlog, a list of features described as user stories. Every day, members hold quick meetings called standups to share progress and problems. This iterative development allows teams to test their work often and improve it based on feedback. Agile helps teams stay flexible, react to changes quickly, and deliver useful results to customers step by step.
